items.text: Salvaged cleaver now hits at intended distance, fixing short-range misses.
Hitbox collision fixes improve melee hit registration.
Raw beef now properly transforms into cooked beef when cooked.
Additional meat varieties are now available to cook in ovens.
Gamepad key bindings no longer get stuck when closing a menu during assignment.
Keyboard input latching bugs (e.g., F1 console opening) have been resolved.
Map can now be closed with the proper key binding.
Multiple animals can now interact correctly when near a vehicle.
Players can now mount gen2 AI animals using the new NPCMountable system.
Apartment complexes and floating cities now appear correctly in the S2P batch window.
Added ferry terminal, enabling vehicle transport across water and new route options.
Introduced outpost structure, providing a forward base with storage and crafting stations.
Added large oilrig, offering high-yield oil extraction and a strategic control point.
Added gas station, allowing refueling of vehicles and generators on the map.
Added radtown, a new settlement type with radiation hazards and loot opportunities.
Added supermarket, providing abundant food supplies and loot.
Added water well (5 variants), granting a reliable fresh water source.
Added apartment complex, offering multi-unit housing and increased storage capacity.
Added floating city (4 variants), introducing large mobile bases with defensive capabilities.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Salvaged cleaver now hits at intended distance, fixing short-range misses.
- Hitbox collision fixes improve melee hit registration.

### Cooking & Food
- Raw beef now properly transforms into cooked beef when cooked.
- Additional meat varieties are now available to cook in ovens.

### UI & Controls
- Gamepad key bindings no longer get stuck when closing a menu during assignment.
- Keyboard input latching bugs (e.g., F1 console opening) have been resolved.
- Map can now be closed with the proper key binding.

### Animals & Mounting
- Multiple animals can now interact correctly when near a vehicle.
- Players can now mount gen2 AI animals using the new NPCMountable system.

### Bug Fixes
- Apartment complexes and floating cities now appear correctly in the S2P batch window.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added ferry terminal, enabling vehicle transport across water and new route options.
- Introduced outpost structure, providing a forward base with storage and crafting stations.
- Added large oilrig, offering high-yield oil extraction and a strategic control point.
- Added gas station, allowing refueling of vehicles and generators on the map.
- Added radtown, a new settlement type with radiation hazards and loot opportunities.
- Added supermarket, providing abundant food supplies and loot.
- Added water well (5 variants), granting a reliable fresh water source.
- Added apartment complex, offering multi-unit housing and increased storage capacity.
- Added floating city (4 variants), introducing large mobile bases with defensive capabilities.

items.text: Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.
Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.
Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.
Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.

2026-09-13.summary:
### Animals & Resources
- Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.

### Weapons
- Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.

### Bug Fixes
- Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.
